title: Munnar Hill Escape
summary: Experience the misty hills, tea plantations and beautiful landscapes of Munnar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Munnar and Scenic Viewpoints
itinerary.description: Arrive in Munnar, stop by waterfalls and tea slopes along the route, visit Pothamedu Viewpoint for panoramic valley views, check into your hotel, and enjoy a relaxed evening.

itinerary.title: Eravikulam National Park and Tea Museum
itinerary.description: Head early to Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai) to spot the Nilgiri tahr, then visit the KDHP Tea Museum and surrounding tea estates before browsing local tea, spice, and chocolate shops.

itinerary.title: Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Mattupetty Dam and lake, Echo Point, and Kundala or Top Station viewpoints as time permits, then check out and depart from Munnar.

title: Alleppey Backwater Retreat
summary: Enjoy Kerala's peaceful backwaters, traditional houseboats and scenic village life.

itinerary.title: Houseboat Check-In and Kuttanad Backwater Cruise
itinerary.description: Board your houseboat around noon with a welcome drink, cruise through Punnamada Lake, Vembanad Lake, and Kuttanad paddy fields with an optional village or canoe stop, and anchor by evening for sunset and an overnight stay on board.

itinerary.title: Morning Cruise, Alleppey Sightseeing and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a morning cruise and breakfast on board before checkout around 9:00 AM, explore local village canals or Alleppey Beach and nearby landmarks, and depart.

title: Wayanad Nature Adventure
summary: Discover Wayanad's forests, waterfalls, wildlife and exciting outdoor experiences.
inclusions: Trekking guide for planned trekking activities

itinerary.title: Arrival in Wayanad and Pookode Lake
itinerary.description: Arrive in Wayanad via the ghat road with a stop at Lakkidi Viewpoint, visit Pookode Lake, and check into your stay for evening relaxation.

itinerary.title: Edakkal Caves and Wildlife Excursion
itinerary.description: Trek up to the prehistoric Edakkal Caves in the morning (closed Mondays) and explore nearby Sulthan Bathery or a forest wildlife sanctuary/jeep safari depending on availability.

itinerary.title: Banasura Sagar Dam and Soochipara Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Visit Banasura Sagar Dam and take a guided nature walk or trek to Soochipara (Sentinel Rock) Waterfalls and surrounding hill trails.

itinerary.title: Morning Leisure and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, take a short morning stop at a local viewpoint or plantation if time permits, check out, and depart from Wayanad.

title: Kochi Heritage Trail
summary: Explore Fort Kochi's colonial architecture, historic streets and vibrant cultural heritage.

itinerary.title: Fort Kochi Waterfront and Colonial Heritage
itinerary.description: Explore Fort Kochi's historic streets, see the Chinese Fishing Nets along the shore, visit St. Francis Church and Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica, and catch an evening cultural performance or waterfront sunset.

itinerary.title: Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town and Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace), stroll through Jew Town and the Paradesi Synagogue area and spice shops, then wrap up sightseeing and depart from Kochi.

title: Varkala Coastal Getaway
summary: Relax along Varkala's beautiful cliffs, beaches and peaceful coastal surroundings.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Varkala Cliff and Papanasam Beach
itinerary.description: Arrive in Varkala, walk along the North Cliff promenade, spend time by Papanasam Beach, browse cliffside cafes and shops, and watch the sunset over the Arabian Sea.

itinerary.title: Coastal Temples, Kappil Lake and Cliff Leisure
itinerary.description: Visit Janardhana Swamy Temple and nearby coastal spots such as Kappil Lake and beach, then return to the cliff in the evening for relaxed dining and local markets.

itinerary.title: Morning Beach Walk and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a morning walk along the beach or cliff, have breakfast and last-minute shopping at local stalls, check out, and depart from Varkala.

title: Hampi Ancient Kingdom
summary: Journey through the magnificent ruins, temples and historic landscapes of the Vijayanagara Empire.

itinerary.title: Arrival, Virupaksha Temple and Hampi Bazaar
itinerary.description: Arrive in Hampi, visit the historic Virupaksha Temple and walk through Hampi Bazaar and nearby Sacred Centre ruins, with sunset views over the boulder landscape.

itinerary.title: Vijaya Vittala Temple, Stone Chariot and Royal Enclosure
itinerary.description: Explore the Vijaya Vittala Temple complex and its iconic Stone Chariot along with the Royal Enclosure and surrounding Vijayanagara monuments.

itinerary.title: Morning Ruins, River Views and Departure
itinerary.description: Take a morning visit to nearby temples or viewpoints along the Tungabhadra river belt, enjoy breakfast, check out, and depart from Hampi.
